body.x: Daegu Techno Park Mobile Convergence Center participated in CES 2013 with 9 of Korean mobile companies. In Sop Song, the director of Daegu Techno Park visited each booths by himself to help companies.
(Photo: In Sop Song, Director of Mobile Convergence Center, is talking with overseas buyers)

As Song director was president of US Company, he expressed determined resolution for the overseas market and to support small businesses. Also he said "the result is important but also to open possibilities for small businesses to grow up. "
" I will pour my effots hard for the rest of my term and make innovative company support system by predicting the result"
This is the Interview we had with Song director at CES 2013.
Please explain Daegu Techno park to us briefly.

There are various special centers in Daegu Techno Park. Among them, Mobile convergence center is pushing special business for mobile. Especially it is planning to support companies specialized in mobile devices.
Please explain to us about marketing business that mobile convergence center supports.
The mobile convergence center supports booths for exhibitions and technologies. And the design of booth is managed by its unique ways to attract people.
Our first goal is to become a world class organization. We are planning to support for companies to meet overseas market.
